searchText: So now that London is done, any hope to increase the block size? miners control the gas limit they can freely vote up by 1/1024 or down by 1/1024 I hope not. Ethereum's rate of state growth is too high for my personal taste. state growth is overrated at least for Erigon I suppose both here and in <#847906692183359568> the topic is related. Out of ignorance, but something that strikes me of that thread posted on <#847906692183359568> is the dycothomy between geth-devs and erigorn/silkworm. I can understand disagreement on certain topics but this one seems odd to me for a number of reasons. First the passionate comments show strong positions for both sides. And second the fact that (at least is my impression) the research group seems to be positioned on one side on the matter. So I would have expected implementers to be aligned with researchers here, or at least not venting publicly on the topic. Nothing wrong, just surprising to me The current gas limit is unambitious It's ok to accept that an average 1990's toaster won't run a full node in 50 years
